citations.long: You lack adequate resources to enable your personnel to perform their functions.
You did not approve or reject components in a manner that ensures compliance with procedures and specifications affecting the identity, strength, quality or purity of a PET drug.
You did not demonstrate that any change does not adversely affect the identity, strength, quality and purity of your PET drug.
When errors occurred or a production batch failed to meet specifications, you did not conduct an investigation when necessary.
You did not follow written quality assurance procedures.
You did not implement procedures to ensure that all your equipment is suitable for its intended purposes.
